artDirection: Tactile editorial material studies for Ratio Design's tall hero carousel

assets.name: chrome-loop
assets.prompt: Create a premium editorial 3D still for the hero carousel of Ratio Design, a contemporary creative studio. A single beautifully bent mirror-polished chrome tubular loop, like a sculptural ribbon, vertically balanced against a vivid acid-lime studio background. Subtle real reflections, exquisite tactile metallic surface, hard directional studio lighting, clean strong shadows, art-directed material study. Portrait 2:3 composition, the sculpture concentrated within the central 40 percent of the image so it crops beautifully into an extra-narrow tall strip. Fill the frame, no typography, no lettering, no logos, no border, no watermark. High-end design magazine aesthetic, not a stock tech graphic.
